title: Roles
intro: Create custom workspace roles and assign members. Choose each role’s access separately when sharing pages and collections. These roles do not grant workspace owner or administrator authority.
name: Role name
archivedHint: Role-based permissions are paused while archived. Memberships and sharing settings remain stored and become effective again after restore.
readOnly: Workspace owners and administrators manage role creation, names and membership. Sharing a page requires permission to manage that page.
pageSharing: Role sharing for the current page
groupScope: Choose a role and access level. Including child pages applies to records and pages that inherit access. Individual denials and inheritance boundaries still apply. Membership changes affect every resource shared with this role.
impact: Review the sharing change for this action. Individual sharing remains. Changes that remove the last page manager are rejected.
draftHint: Save or restore the name before changing membership, sharing or archive status. If another input is selected, apply it or reset its selection before saving the name.
actorChanged: The account changed or the session could not be verified. Close and sign in again.
forbidden: Permission to manage this workspace or page could not be verified.
lastManager: This change would remove the last page manager. Add another manager before reviewing it again.
archivedReadonly: Archived roles cannot be changed. Reload to check the saved state.
conflict: Saved content or membership changed. Review your input and reload before trying again.
invalid: Enter a nonempty name of at most 100 characters without control characters.
tooLarge: The role, member or sharing limit was reached.
unknown: The save result could not be confirmed. Do not resend automatically. Confirm discarding the input, reload the list and check the saved state.
refreshFailed: The save completed, but the view could not be refreshed. Reload to check it without resending.
unavailable: Roles could not be loaded. Try reloading later.
localeFallbackNotice: Some labels use English. Page names and content are not translated.
archiveReview: Archive {name} and pause permissions provided by this role.
restoreReview: Restore {name} and reactivate its retained sharing settings.
shareReview: Share the current page with {name} using "{permission}". Child pages are excluded.
revokeReview: Revoke role sharing for {name} on the current page.
descendantGrantLocked: This role includes child pages. Changing its scope requires management access to every descendant.
revokeDescendantsReview: Revoke role sharing for {name}. This affects the current page and child pages that inherit this sharing.
resourceRoleHint: Members of this role receive the access selected below. Create roles and assign members in workspace settings.
shareDescendantsReview: Give {name} {permission} access to this page and record or child pages that inherit sharing.
